Step 1 read each advert and named, in the advert's own terms, every property of the offer a candidate could weigh — pay, hours, contract, place, language, qualifications, physical demands, sector, tooling, team, progression — with a verbatim quote for each and no dimension id anywhere in the output. Step 2 mapped those names to dimensions through an explicit ordered rule table, and whatever no rule reached is recorded here with dimension null. Concepts outside a dimension's own definition were left unmapped rather than pushed to its low end: a cleaning round is not technical_depth at -0.6, it is outside technical_depth. Scope: properties of the offer, not an itemised task list; an itemised task ontology would measure the model against something it never claimed to be.
